biotools.summary: ConsensuSV-ONT is a tool for accurate structural variant calling from Oxford Nanopore sequencing data. It combines six SV callers and a convolutional neural network within a Nextflow pipeline wrapped in a Docker image, providing a user-friendly solution for long-read variant detection.
